newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians, Israeli troops clash in Hebron.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians, Israeli troops clash in Hebron.

text.p: Israeli soldiers shot rubber bullets in the air to disperse Palestinian protesters who threw stones at a Jewish enclave in the West Bank town of Hebron on Friday, but no one was hurt, witnesses said.

Some 50 Palestinian protesters threw stones from the Palestinian-ruled part of the town at the enclave where 400 settlers live under Israeli control. Israel handed most of the city to PLO rule in January under a peace deal.
Palestinian police arrived to disperse the crowd after the Israelis fired rubber-coated metal bullets.

Hebron has been a flashpoint of Israeli-Palestinian clashes since Israel began building a new Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem last March. Palestinians fear Israel is strengthening its hold on the half of the city they want as the capital of a future state.
